summary: textarea field type added after initial implementation. Motivation: prose fields (summaries, notes, descriptions) need multiline plain-string input, not JSON-object input. The existing object/array Text widget parsed its content as JSON, which was wrong for plain prose.
decision_or_outcome: Added _is_textarea() check: type=string with format=textarea creates a plain Text widget with _textarea=True marker. _get_value returns raw string (rstrip newline), not JSON-parsed. _set_value inserts str(value) without JSON-encoding. Labelled Browse tab added to show context while browsing.
